title: Map an Android app automatically on a real phone, then test every path
description:
Point VirtualPyTest at an app on a real phone. Here it's Google TV on an Android phone, starting from an empty map with only the home screen. One click reads the app's screens: Search, Shop, Library and Watchlist. Each screen is opened and left again on the phone, both ways, and all 8 paths pass. 
Every screen gets a check and a screenshot, then the map is saved and laid out automatically. 
To use it, click a screen and choose Go To: the phone follows the path from the map.

Open source and free.
